trials.stimulus:
In this study, you will read short scenarios. Each one contains a blank, marked [ ___ ], for you to fill in with a word or phrase of your choosing.

Please read the scenario carefully and type words or phrases that would naturally fill the blank, given the situation described. After typing each option, press Enter to add it as its own tag — you can add as few or as many as you like.

If you think the sentence works fine without anything in the blank, please enter "none".

You will first see two practice examples, then move on to the 24 scenarios in the main study. There are no right or wrong answers — we are interested in your intuitive judgment.

When you are ready to begin, press the start button.

Practice 2

Yamada had meetings all morning and [ ___ ] had no time for lunch.

Type any word that could go in the blank above and press Enter. There are no right or wrong answers — many different words could fit, so enter as many as come to mind.
